summary: Delivery1051 now implements the distinct native lifecycle and actual consumer source route rather than the earlier constructor-only slice. F# owns joined source and action identities, admission, results and cleanup; Python supplies bounded IO and emergency mechanisms. Full5400/capability1200 original-clock profiles remain distinct from the unchanged legacy2700/attempt2 protocol; retired Coordination917/956 are not revived. Raw commit/tree reconstruction, held modes/inodes, consumption revalidation, child settlement and remote conclusion/credential-retirement joins remain mandatory. Source qualification freezes the canonical seven-member runtime archive once before actual acquisition controls and retains its two-file artifact only after successful original protected-main qualification. The nonpackable producer uses an immutable GitHub release archive, not a new NuGet cut. The separate manifest binds source/tree, five runtime files, binding/provenance and nine adapters. A registered built-in-token writer uses the existing ADR0097 pinned lock and requires exact current main, original Actions qualification/check/artifact provenance, reviewed digests and no prior publisher attempt for that source. Its four writes journal possible-send before transport: immutable tag, draft release, frozen asset, publication; make_latest=false preserves the CLI latest pointer. Absolute deadline checks reject late positive responses. Unknown responses stop progression; original readback cannot resend, overwrite or delete and matches known operation/release/asset identities plus unauthenticated served bytes. These source contracts do not select dispatch, publication, adoption, recipient keys or a native run. Actual qualified runtime/host, release/asset IDs, same-run P2 bytes and packet/ciphertext custody remain required inputs; genuine image/P2, remote retirement, refusal/rollback and legacy replacement acceptance remain separate. Root owns those selections and the full declared promise/original attempts remain open. GitHub rejects runner.temp in job-level env; custody paths use supported step contexts, and always-retention derives its exact path independently so missing prior-step state cannot select a broad fallback. Actions artifact ZIP endpoints negotiate JSON Accept before binary redirects; release-asset binary endpoints retain octet-stream negotiation. HTTP errors are refused before ZIP size/digest checks, so an unsupported Accept415 cannot be classified as archive corruption. Preserve the failed source preflight separately from correct-header diagnostics; diagnostics cannot qualify adoption or publication. A transport repair requires its own normal source delivery, fresh protected-main qualification and actual source-owned preflight.
title: FourD native acquisition and frozen producer publication retain distinct acceptance gates
